rows.text: Selvala taps for mana equal to the greatest power among your creatures, so one big body turns her into a mana engine. The deck ramps with elves into a single huge creature, untaps Selvala to double the mana, and spends it on more huge creatures, each of which also draws a card off her. It ends with Craterhoof Behemoth or a team-wide pump the turn after everything lands.

rows.name: Selvala, Heart of the Wilds
rows.text: three mana. {G}, {T}: add X mana in any combination of colours, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control. Whenever another creature enters, its controller may draw a card if its power is greater than every other creature's.
The draw is symmetric. Your 9/9 entering draws you a card; an opponent's creature that becomes the biggest on the battlefield draws THEM one. Keep the biggest creature on your side.
With only Selvala out, X is 2: she needs a fatty or a pump to do anything big.

rows.name: Selvala, Heart of the Wilds + Bygone Colossus
rows.text: warp the Colossus for {3} and Selvala taps for 9 that turn. You draw a card as it enters as the biggest creature. Warp exiles it at end of turn, but you can cast it again later.

rows.name: Selvala, Heart of the Wilds + Quirion Ranger
rows.text: return a Forest to untap Selvala once a turn: the same big X twice.

rows.name: Selvala, Heart of the Wilds + Scryb Ranger
rows.text: the same untap, with flash and protection from blue.

rows.name: Selvala, Heart of the Wilds + Wirewood Symbiote
rows.text: return an Elf (Selvala is one) to untap a creature. Bounce a mana elf to untap Selvala, then replay the elf.

rows.name: Selvala, Heart of the Wilds + Zopandrel, Hunger Dominus
rows.text: Zopandrel doubles every creature's power at the beginning of each combat. Tap Selvala after combat starts and X doubles.

rows.name: Hyrax Tower Scout
rows.text: enters and untaps Selvala.

rows.name: Temur Sabertooth + Hyrax Tower Scout + Selvala, Heart of the Wilds
rows.text: pay {1}{G} to return the Scout and recast it for {2}{G} to untap Selvala; with her own {G}, a loop costs six. Once she taps for seven or more (one 7-power creature), every loop makes mana, as much as you like. Each recast is also a creature entering, which can draw off Selvala. A three-card loop, so it fits Bracket 3.

rows.name: Great Oak Guardian
rows.text: flash; your whole team gets +2/+2 and untaps. X goes up by 2 and Selvala taps again.

rows.name: Legolas's Quick Reflexes
rows.text: split second: untap Selvala with hexproof.

rows.name: Concordant Crossroads
rows.text: everything has haste, so this turn's fatty can attack and Selvala can tap the turn she arrives. Opponents' creatures get haste too.

rows.name: Craterhoof Behemoth
rows.text: haste, and every creature gets trample and +X/+X, where X is the number of creatures you control. With eight creatures out that is usually lethal.

rows.name: Pathbreaker Ibex
rows.text: when it attacks, the team gets trample and +X/+X equal to your greatest power.

rows.name: Zopandrel, Hunger Dominus
rows.text: doubles every creature's power and toughness at each combat.

rows.name: Finale of Devastation
rows.text: with X of ten or more, fetch any creature and give the team +X/+X and haste.

rows.name: Ghalta, Primal Hunger
rows.text: costs {X} less for your creatures' total power: often two mana. A 12/12 trampler and a Selvala draw.

rows.name: Kogla, the Titan Ape
rows.text: fights a creature on entering, and destroys an artifact or enchantment on each attack.

rows.name: Elder Gargaroth
rows.text: a 6/6 that makes a Beast, gains 3 or draws whenever it attacks or blocks.

rows.name: Garruk, Primal Hunter
rows.text: 3/3 Beasts every turn, or −3 to draw equal to your greatest power.

rows.name: Invasion of Ikoria
rows.text: X sets the mana value it fetches from library or graveyard; defeat it in combat for Zilortha.

rows.name: Beast Whisperer
rows.text: a card for every creature spell you cast.

rows.name: Guardian Project
rows.text: a card for every new creature with a fresh name.

rows.name: Regal Force
rows.text: a card for each green creature you control.

rows.name: Rishkar's Expertise
rows.text: draw equal to your greatest power, then cast a five-drop free.

rows.name: Return of the Wildspeaker
rows.text: draw equal to your greatest non-Human power, or +3/+3 to the team.

rows.name: Momentous Fall
rows.text: sacrifice a creature: draw cards equal to its power.

rows.name: Disciple of Freyalise
rows.text: sacrifice another creature on entering: draw and gain life equal to its power. It doubles as a land.

rows.name: Last March of the Ents
rows.text: draw equal to your greatest toughness, then put any number of creatures from your hand onto the battlefield.

rows.name: Sylvan Library
rows.text: pick the best of three every turn.

rows.name: The One Ring
rows.text: protection for a turn, then a card every upkeep. Collector Ouphe turns it off.

guide.title: Tutor lines — what to fetch, and when

rows.name: Natural Order -> Craterhoof Behemoth
rows.text: sacrifice a green creature (a spent mana elf) and Hoof goes straight onto the battlefield with haste. With five or more other creatures out, swing for the game.

rows.name: Eldritch Evolution -> Craterhoof Behemoth
rows.text: sacrifice a six-drop (Kogla, Pathbreaker Ibex or Disciple of Freyalise) for a creature of mana value up to eight, straight onto the battlefield.

rows.name: Summoner's Pact -> Craterhoof Behemoth
rows.text: free now; pay {2}{G}{G} next upkeep or lose. Only when Selvala can cast the Hoof THIS turn.

rows.name: Fierce Empath -> Zopandrel, Hunger Dominus
rows.text: any creature of mana value 6 or more to hand.

rows.name: Survival of the Fittest -> Bygone Colossus
rows.text: discard any creature to fetch any creature. Discarded fatties come back with Finale of Devastation.

rows.name: Woodland Bellower -> Priest of Titania
rows.text: any nonlegendary green creature of mana value 3 or less, straight onto the battlefield: Priest for mana, Quirion Ranger or Hyrax Tower Scout for untaps.

rows.name: Green Sun's Zenith -> Quirion Ranger
rows.text: X = 1 for the untap engine, or a bigger X for a fatty.

rows.name: Chord of Calling -> Great Oak Guardian
rows.text: instant speed, convoked by your elves.

rows.name: Nature's Rhythm -> Beast Whisperer
rows.text: any creature onto the battlefield; harmonize lets you cast it again from the graveyard.

rows.name: Shared Summons -> Craterhoof Behemoth
rows.text: two creatures with different names to hand: Hoof plus an untap creature.

rows.name: Tooth and Nail
rows.text: entwined at nine mana, it puts Craterhoof and a second fatty straight onto the battlefield.

rows.name: Turntimber Symbiosis
rows.text: puts a creature from your top seven onto the battlefield.

rows.name: Growing Rites of Itlimoc
rows.text: digs four for a creature; with four creatures out at your end step it flips into a land that taps for {G} per creature.

rows.name: Formidable Speaker
rows.text: discard a card to tutor a creature to hand, and it untaps a permanent each turn.

rows.name: Llanowar Elves
rows.text: {G} on turn one.

rows.name: Elvish Mystic
rows.text: the second copy.

rows.name: Fyndhorn Elves
rows.text: the third.

rows.name: Birds of Paradise
rows.text: any colour, flying.

rows.name: Delighted Halfling
rows.text: mana that makes Selvala uncounterable.

rows.name: Arbor Elf
rows.text: untaps a Forest; with Utopia Sprawl or Wild Growth, that is two mana.

rows.name: Priest of Titania
rows.text: {G} for every Elf on the battlefield, Selvala included.

rows.name: Fanatic of Rhonas
rows.text: {G}{G}{G}{G} once you have a 4-power creature.

rows.name: Elvish Spirit Guide

rows.text: the usual.

rows.name: Lotus Petal
rows.text: free.

rows.name: Castle Garenbrig

rows.name: Wirewood Lodge
rows.text: untaps an Elf, Selvala included.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep two lands, a mana elf or two, and Selvala. Turn two Selvala off a turn-one elf is the strongest start.
Turn three or four, land one fatty (Bygone Colossus, Ghalta, a tutored six-drop) and Selvala's X jumps to five or more.
Then find an untap creature, double the mana, and find Craterhoof Behemoth with Natural Order or Eldritch Evolution.
